note: 'label_anchor' is a tooltip point in the node's local frame. Animate node 'pod_mount' between mount_poses (local to root = world). Toggle 'offset_arm' visibility: visible only in offset45. Empties pose_toprail/pose_offset45 and orbit_target_* carry the same transforms in the GLB; 'orbit_target' (child of pod_mount) follows the pod.

toprail.note: Pod on the receiver rail between the sights; hide offset_arm.

offset45.note: Pod on the 45-degree offset arm, canted toward the shooter; show offset_arm.

default_camera.note: Framed on the pod; rifle extends out of frame. For toprail use orbit_targets.toprail with the same offset.

knob.note: Rotate about rotation_axis_local (EC11 detented encoder, 20 detents/rev = 18 deg). Turn = brightness, click = next screen mode.

screen.uv: UV 0..1 fills the circular display (u = right, v = up as seen by the shooter)
screen.uv_rotation_note: Firmware keeps the horizon level when canted (fw/test/test_ui_rotation.cpp); rotate texture content by this angle (CCW, about UV centre) in each pose.

screen_modes.cycle: knob click (guide: click cycles Radar / Thermal / Hybrid)

radar.label: Radar
radar.description: Heading (NE 042 degrees) and radar contacts on a range-ring sweep.

thermal.label: Thermal
thermal.description: Thermal camera view (55 degrees) with tagged targets and a heading strip.

hybrid.label: Hybrid
hybrid.description: Radar sweep with thermal thumbnails on each contact.

parts.name: Upper & lower receiver
parts.description: M4-pattern receiver with flat-top Picatinny rail - the mounting base for SynScope.

parts.name: Barrel & handguard
parts.description: 14.5-inch barrel, quad-rail handguard, front sight post and flash hider.

parts.name: Collapsible stock
parts.description: Adjustable stock on the buffer tube.

parts.name: Flip-up rear sight
parts.description: Deployed iron-sight leaf with a precision aperture; the sightline runs from here to the front post.

parts.name: 45-degree offset mount
parts.description: Picatinny clamp with a 45-degree arm: moves SynScope clear of your sightline and tilts the display toward you. Show only in the offset45 pose.

parts.name: SynScope radar pod
parts.description: Rugged rail-mounted radar sensor: ASA housing and RF-transparent radome.

parts.name: Display
parts.description: Circular screen: heading (NE 042 degrees) and live radar contacts at a glance. Swap screen-<mode>.webp to change mode.

parts.name: Control knob
parts.description: Gloved-hand rotary knob: turn for brightness, click to cycle Radar / Thermal / Hybrid.

parts.name: Sightline
parts.description: Line from rear aperture to front post. Unlit material - tint red when blocked (toprail) or accent #dd8c33 when clear (offset45).
